name: Raptor Horns
summary: In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix wants intact raptor horns for a scheme of his own. The goblin believes the cunning of Barrens raptors lies in their horns and hires travelers to hunt Sunscale Scytheclaws.

sections.title: Goblin Entrepreneurship
sections.body: Mebok Mizzyrix looks for fortune in Ratchet, where goblins chase one scheme after another. He has watched the Barrens raptors act with unusual craft and coordination compared with beasts elsewhere. Mebok decided their intelligence must be held in their horns. He has no formal inquiry in mind; he wants to put this idea to profit.

sections.title: The Sunscale Scytheclaws
sections.body: Mebok wants undamaged horns from Sunscale Scytheclaws, among the Barrens' deadliest predators. They prowl the southern stretches of the Barrens and the northern borders near Ashenvale. The raptors hunt in packs and defend their territory fiercely, so bringing down one and taking its horns intact calls for considerable skill in battle.

sections.title: A Recipe for Riches
sections.body: Mebok plans to grind the intact horns into fine powder and brew the powder into drinks. He calls the concoctions “smart drinks” and hopes to sell them to patrons eager to buy wit in a bottle. Mebok is convinced the scheme will make him wealthy overnight.

faq.q: Why does Mebok Mizzyrix want raptor horns?
faq.answer: Mebok believes the cunning of Barrens raptors is stored in their horns. He plans to grind them into powder, brew “smart drinks,” and sell them for profit.
Sunscale Scytheclaws roam the southern Barrens and the northern stretches near the Ashenvale border.

faq.q: Are raptor horns actually magical or mind-enhancing?
faq.answer: Mebok's claim that raptor horns hold their wit is goblin pseudoscience driven by profit. The Barrens raptors are cunning, but the entry gives no grounds to call their horns magical or mind-enhancing.
Mebok Mizzyrix is an ambitious goblin merchant in Ratchet, the port town. He pursues dubious schemes and concoctions to make a fortune from travelers passing through.

faq.q: What happens after collecting the horns?
faq.answer: Mebok plans to grind the intact horns into powder and brew them into drinks he calls “smart drinks.”

faq.q: Can Alliance players help Mebok with this task?
faq.answer: Yes. Ratchet is an open port managed by the Steamwheedle Cartel, and Mebok is a neutral goblin who does business with both the Horde and the Alliance.

angles.text: As a hunter familiar with Kalimdor's raptor packs, you know their deadly cunning. Mebok's belief that their wit can be bottled is goblin quackery.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can find a neutral foothold in the Horde-dominated Barrens at Ratchet. Odd jobs like Mebok's offer a chance to earn coin and Steamwheedle favor.
